test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Perumal has given a challenging assignment to the newly admitted students.

options.text: A challenging assignment has been given by Perumal to the newly admitted students.
A challenging assignment will have been given by Perumal to the newly admitted students.
A challenging assignment was given by Perumal to the newly admitted students.
A challenging assignment had been given by Perumal to the newly admitted students.

solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. A challenging assignment has been given by Perumal to the newly admitted students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In passive voice, the focus is on the action and the object rather than the subject.
 
• The original sentence is in the present perfect tense, **"has given."**
 
• The correct passive voice form for the present perfect tense is **"has been given."**
 
• **Option 2 **("A challenging assignment will have been given") is in the future perfect tense, which does not match the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3** ("A challenging assignment was given") is in the simple past tense, which does not match the original sentence.
 
• Option 4 ("A challenging assignment had been given") is in the past perfect tense, which does not match the original sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
